name: ai-keys help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:ai-keys. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Test and save
entries.text: Tests the key against Anthropic and saves it only if it works.

entries.title: Save name
entries.text: Saves the key's name (the key itself doesn't change).

entries.title: Write to the VPS now
entries.text: Copies the active key to the VPS so headless Claude Code uses it too.

entries.title: Test access token
entries.text: Sends one tiny message with just this account's access token. Nothing is renewed, so it's safe to run any time.

entries.title: Test the pair
entries.text: Checks the access and refresh tokens together. The refresh token gets a new access token, so both are renewed.

entries.title: Higher priority
entries.text: Moves the account up one place. When the active account hits a limit, accounts higher up are tried first.

entries.title: Lower priority
entries.text: Moves the account down one place. When the active account hits a limit, accounts lower down are tried later.

entries.title: Add account
entries.text: Opens the step-by-step wizard for adding a Claude account. Each key is checked as you enter it.

entries.title: Make it the active account now
entries.text: When ticked, the new account becomes the active one as soon as it's saved, for the assistant and the VPS.

entries.title: Put it at the top of the priority list
entries.text: When ticked, the new account goes first in the list the automatic switch follows.

entries.title: Account name
entries.text: A name for the account so you can tell it apart. The email is looked up by itself when it's saved.

entries.title: /login finished and I'm back at the terminal
entries.text: Tick this once /login has finished in the VPS terminal. The wizard won't go on until you do.

entries.title: Contents of .credentials.json
entries.text: Paste what `cat ~/.claude-add/.credentials.json` printed. It's checked the moment you continue.

entries.title: Manage Claude accounts
entries.text: Opens Manage Claude accounts: every account in priority order, with tests, drag to reorder, and Add account.
